reviewed_by: Claude review of the floating Agent view
reason: The Agent view was reachable only as a tab in the conversation drawer. The composer's Agent view button now opens it as a floating, non-modal panel over the conversation that can be moved, resized, minimized to a launcher, docked back into the conversation's details and popped out again, with its placement and geometry remembered per device and a bottom sheet on phones. The timeline, snapshot body, follow/stop logic and status line moved into a shared AgentViewBody so the floating and docked placements render the same view; ChatResultStream is now the docked placement with a Pop out control. The frontend selection covers the panel (placement and geometry storage, clamping, first placement clear of the toolbar and composer, keyboard move and resize, Escape to minimize, the launcher and its counts, the phone sheet) and the docked stream (follow, stop, back to newest, pop out). The Playwright selection is the structured-results area, which renders the explorer in every placement and now includes an end-to-end journey on desktop, narrow, mobile Chromium and mobile WebKit: open from the composer with focus inside, the composer usable underneath, axe on the panel, keyboard move, Escape to a launcher and back to the same place, dock with focus on Pop out, the choice surviving a reload, pop out, and close returning focus to the composer button, plus the sheet on phones.
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No Python test is selected because no Python changed: publishing, retention and the REST API are untouched. No native tests are selected because no Rust changed. No real-Core entry is selected: the view reads the same list and detail endpoints as before, which the structured-results Python tests and mock-backed journeys cover, and placement is purely client-side. The assistant area was run locally on desktop: 49 passed, and the 2 failures (conversation More actions on mobile Workbench navigation; a provider turn that thinks without answering) fail identically on origin/main without this change. The critical-workspaces area passed locally on desktop.
